_comment: Town events (M16b, A47). Scheduled/emergent scenes that exist independently of the transformation. An event pulls listed households toward a place, runs for some blocks, then resolves — even if the subject is absent. `bond` deltas apply between attendees by relationship type (default catches the rest).

events.label: a neighbour's barbecue
lines: {here} end up at the barbecue, smoke and small talk drifting across the park
the barbecue draws {here} together over the grille

events.label: the season fair
lines: {here} wander the season fair together, shirtsleeves and string lights
the fair sets up along the street and {here} drift through it

events.label: a power cut
lines: the lights die across the block; {here} share candles and lowered voices
a power cut strands {here} at home in the dark, finding things to say

events.label: an impromptu cafe meet
lines: {here} end up sharing a table at the cafe by accident
a queue at the cafe leaves {here} waiting and talking together
